app_fee.value: Applicants must pay a $70 nonrefundable application fee after submitting the application (applications are not reviewed until payment is processed).
app_fee.quote: After you submit your application, you will be required to pay the $70 nonrefundable application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are automatic only for Rutgers alumni (any campus) and U.S. military service members/veterans using GI Bill benefits; fee deferments (not waivers) may be requested under extraordinary circumstances.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are only granted in specific cases outlined below, and deferments are considered under extraordinary circumstances. | Rutgers Alumni: Alumni from any Rutgers campus are automatically eligible for an application fee waiver. | U.S. Military Service Members and Veterans: Applicants currently serving in the U.S. Military or Veterans using GI Bill benefits automatically qualify for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements vary by program across Rutgers Graduate School-Camden; see individual program records.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 4.5 on the new scale (for tests taken through January 21, 2026, section minimums are Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, Listening 17).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL IBT & IBT Home Edition | The Rutgers Code is 2790 | 4.5* | *For TOEFL exams taken through January 21, 2026, the minimum requirements are Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, and Listening 17.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall band score is 6.5 (select 'Rutgers University Undergraduate and Graduate Programs').
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic | Choose: Rutgers University Undergraduate and Graduate Programs | 6.5

english_waiver.value: English proficiency scores are not required for applicants awarded a degree from an English-instruction institution, U.S. accredited institution, or English-speaking country, provided the applicant notifies camgrad@rutgers.edu to request the exemption.
english_waiver.quote: English language scores are not required for applicants when applicants have been: | Awarded a Degree from an English-Instruction Institution | Awarded a Degree from a U.S. Regionally Accredited Institution | Awarded a Degree in an English Speaking Country | If any of the aforementioned situations apply to your case, kindly alert us at camgrad@rutgers.edu.

notes: Public Carnegie R2 campus of Rutgers University in Camden, New Jersey. Graduate School of Arts and Sciences-Camden offers four Ph.D. programs total, of which only Computational & Integrative Biology (CCIB) is within the 18 STEM Atlas fields (Childhood Studies, Prevention Science, and Public Affairs/Community Development are humanities/social/behavioral-intervention doctorates; Biology, Chemistry & Molecular Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Forensic Science, and Mathematical Sciences are M.S.-only; Nursing offers DNP only). Note CCIB's older FAQ lists legacy TOEFL 70 for enrollment while deferring official TOEFL policy to the Graduate School.
